meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 GitHub 上的代码改动变成一段讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚合并一批改动,想快速录一段讲解给团队或用户看。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub pull request into a video that explains the code change
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just merged changes and want a quick explainer video for your team or users.

howto.what: 给它一个 GitHub PR，它会读 diff、commit 和文件，先规划逐帧讲解脚本，再逐帧搭建视频，最终产出 renders/video.mp4 的代码变更讲解片（变更日志、新功能、修复或重构走查）。
howto.when: 当你给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#N，或在已检出仓库里说「这个 PR」时触发；输入必须是代码变更，产品宣传、无 PR 的话题讲解或其他不确定意图都不走它。

say.text: 把这个 PR 做成一支讲解视频：<PR 链接>
say.note: 先抓 diff 和 commit，再规划分镜

say.text: 用男声给这个 PR 的讲解视频配音
say.note: 默认配音是 Marcia 女声

say.text: 这个 PR 按重构走查的风格来讲

howto.what_en: Give it a GitHub PR and Claude reads the diff, commits and files, plans a frame-by-frame script, builds the frames, and renders a code-change explainer (changelog, feature, fix or refactor) to video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a PR URL, an owner/repo#N ref, or say "this PR" in a checked-out repo. The input must be a code change; promos and no-PR topics do not go here.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into an explainer video: <PR link>
say_en.note: Fetches diff and commits, then plans frames

say_en.text: Narrate this PR's video with a male voice
Explain this PR as a refactor walkthrough
